raw_market.question: Will Erv have the highest ACS at VALORANT Champions 2026?

This market will resolve according to which player records the highest ACS (Average Combat Score) across all maps played during VALORANT Champions 2026 (also known as VCT Champions 2026), currently scheduled for September 24 to October 18, 2026, in Shanghai, China.

Only players who play at least 8 maps at VALORANT Champions 2026 are eligible for this market. Players who play fewer than 8 maps are excluded regardless of their ACS, and this market will resolve according to the highest ACS among eligible players.

If two or more players are tied for the highest ACS, this market will resolve to the player with the higher total kills across the entire event. If a tie persists, this market will resolve to the player with the lower total deaths across the entire event. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to the player whose listed in-game name comes first alphabetically.

If a player not listed in this market records the highest ACS among eligible players, this market will resolve to "Other".

If VALORANT Champions 2026 is canceled, or is postponed such that it has not concluded by November 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be the vlr.gg event stats page (https://www.vlr.gg/event/stats/2766/valorant-champions-2026). However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
